common_name: Bobby Miller Daylily (2016 AHS Achievement Medal Winner)

planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in full sun, average well-drained soil.

directions: Bobby Miller was entered as three matching scapes before a panel of senior exhibition judges, winning hybridizer Landon B. Davis the American Hemerocallis Society's Achievement Medal in 2016. The award singles out exceptional seedling-stage performance in accredited AHS flower shows, a step that often precedes formal registration and wider release. Grow divisions in full sun in average, well-drained soil, letting the clump settle in during its first season before full bloom develops. Divide congested fans every three to four years in spring to keep flowering vigorous.
